Week 3, May 16, 2026 in Provo MTC

Week 2.5-- Last Week at the MTC!

Hey everyone! Firstly, I would like to thank Sister Hall for the quote last week. Also, as the title suggests, this was my last full week at the MTC. There won't be an email next week because I'll be in Florida! So my next email will be on Monday the 25th.

We went to the temple three times this week! We did endowments on Tuesday, parent-child sealings on Friday and endowments again this morning. The first two trips were to the Mt. Tempanogos temple and the one today was at the Provo City Center temple.

I'd also like to congratulate my brother and his new wife as of today! Pierce and Jess I love you both so much and I would've loved to be there with you today (in more than just cardboard cut-out)!

Highlights of the week:

  • Almost the entire district sang in the MTC chior for the General Authority (church leader) devoional! Elder Ronald M. Barcellos spoke about what it means to give our lives to the Lord during our missions.
  • Elder Calabresi hurt his thumb on a sock
  • We went to the temple three times!
  • I got my travel itinerary for Wednesday! I'm leaving the MTC at 4:30 am with Sister Nelson and eight other missionaries.
  • I found out Sister Nelson sang in the April 2025 Saturday morning session of General Conference! She has a picture of her in the chior and she's super cute :)
  • I got a replacement sweater to the one that got stolen out of the laundry room last week!
  • I ran into a couple people I knew from my mission prep class during my fall semester at BYUI. One of them left on Tuesday, which was sad. I miss seeing her around, but I'm sure she's doing amazing :)

Monkey-off: who makes the best monkey noise? -- Sister Nelson vs Elder Calabresi --

Respond with your vote and I'll put the tally in my next email! If the video doesn't work for whatever reason, it's on my Google Photos (https://photos.app.goo.gl/zbkEaPjHsA1Tix1C7).
